items.title: COP17 concludes with countries agreeing biodiversity action is off track, but falls short on solutions
items.summary: The UN’s COP17 biodiversity summit has concluded in Yerevan, Armenia, with countries agreeing that global progress towards the 2030 targets is off track and setting out a pathway to accelerate action and mobilise finance.

items.title: COP17: Key outcomes agreed at the UN biodiversity conference in Yerevan
items.summary: Countries have completed the first “global review” of their progress towards reversing nature loss by 2030 at the COP17 biodiversity talks in Yerevan, Armenia.

items.title: ‘Obscene’: Oil giant profits double to $89bn
items.summary: Oil giants such as BP, Shell and Equinor have raked in billions in the latest quarter, with new research finding that profits have doubled compared to the same period last year.

items.title: Apply now: Entries open for the edie Awards 2027
items.summary: The UK’s largest corporate sustainability awards scheme is celebrating its 20th year with a restructured programme, built around three pillars and new categories including AI, water and adaptation.

Who Builds the Systems Green Capabilities Need? – Professor Ioannis Ioannou
items.summary: Companies that invest early in green capabilities earn a return only where the infrastructure, markets and rules they depend on are in place, so firms and governments have to build those systems together.

items.title: SeABank Splits New Sustainable Finance Framework Across Green, Blue and Social Projects
items.summary: Southeast Asia Commercial Joint Stock Bank (SeABank, HOSE: SSB) has published a Sustainable Finance Framework to guide its sustainable funding.

items.title: Google Hackathon Winners Target Solar Siting, Wildfire Shutoffs and Grid Hardening in Colorado
items.summary: Google hosted the second annual Colorado Impact Hackathon at its Boulder offices, where students worked on one question.

items.title: Iberdrola Returns to US Debt Market With $1.6 Billion Green Bond
items.summary: Iberdrola has sold $1.6 billion of green bonds in the US debt market, aimed at institutional investors inside and outside the United States.
